notes: 'As of' read as one rendering of `כְּ` under rule 30, in parallel with the 'as with' of JOB.41.5; the competing reading marks the 'of' `added`.
The italic 'burning' is `added` — it predicates something of the rushes the Hebrew does not write — while 'boiling' is the written participle `נָפוּחַ`.
